independent_reference.source: Lorenz, E. N. (1963), 'Deterministic Nonperiodic Flow', J. Atmos. Sci. 20 (2), 130-141 (eqs. 25-27 plus immediately-following fixed-point algebra). Also Sparrow, C. (1982), 'The Lorenz Equations', § 1.2 ('steady states'), p. 7 (ISBN 0-387-90775-0). Also Strogatz, S. H. (1994), 'Nonlinear Dynamics and Chaos', § 9.2.1 ('fixed points'), ISBN 0-201-54344-3. Three independent published derivations of the same closed-form fixed-point coordinates at canonical (sigma, rho, beta) = (10, 28, 8/3); plus a hand-derivation in the derivation .md § 1.
independent_reference.derived_by: hand-derivation cross-checked against Sparrow 1982 § 1.2 and Strogatz 1994 § 9.2.1; SymPy generator re-verifies symbolically

independent_reference.source: Sparrow, C. (1982), 'The Lorenz Equations', § 1.2 ('linearization at origin'), p. 8 (ISBN 0-387-90775-0). Also Strogatz, S. H. (1994), 'Nonlinear Dynamics and Chaos', § 9.2.2 ('linear stability of the origin'), ISBN 0-201-54344-3. Also hand-derivation in derivation .md § 2 from the Jacobian's block-triangular structure (one eigenvalue is immediately -beta; the 2x2 block's characteristic polynomial gives the quadratic formula above). Three independent derivations agree on lambda_{1,2} = (-(sigma+1) +/- sqrt((sigma+1)^2 + 4*sigma*(rho-1)))/2 and lambda_3 = -beta.
independent_reference.derived_by: hand-derivation of block-triangular characteristic polynomial; SymPy generator re-evaluates and cross-checks

independent_reference.source: Lorenz, E. N. (1963), 'Deterministic Nonperiodic Flow', J. Atmos. Sci. 20 (2), 130-141, § 'Some general considerations' (p. 137): the divergence is stated explicitly. Also Sparrow, C. (1982), 'The Lorenz Equations', § 1.1 ('dissipation rate'), p. 6. Also hand-derivation from trace of the 3x3 Jacobian (derivation .md § 3) — note tr(J) is independent of x because the only x- and y-dependent entries of J live off the diagonal.
independent_reference.derived_by: trace of the Jacobian matrix; cross-checked against Lorenz 1963 p. 137 and Sparrow 1982 § 1.1
